en.title: [2027 Academic Year Major Transfer] Detailed Schedule for Department Interviews and Practical Tests
summary: Notice regarding the major transfer application schedule, official English test score submission, and department interviews/practical tests for the 2027 academic year.
Official English test score submission must be turned in to your current department office by January 4, 2027 (Mon).
Major transfer application is open from January 6, 2027 (Wed) 10:00 to January 7, 2027 (Thu) 16:00.
Department interviews and practical tests will take place on January 12, 2027 (Tue) for evaluating departments only; check the attachments for exact times, locations, and formats.
Successful applicants are scheduled to be announced on the website on January 19, 2027 (Tue) at 14:00.
en.easyExplanation: This notice provides the application and interview/practical test schedule for students applying for a major transfer for the 2027 academic year. Official English test scores must be submitted to your current department office by January 4, 2027 (Mon), and online applications run from January 6, 2027 (Wed) 10:00 to January 7, 2027 (Thu) 16:00. Applicants for departments requiring interviews or practical tests must attend them on January 12, 2027 (Tue), so please check the attachment for detailed schedules.
en.target: Applicants for the 2027 academic year major transfer (interviews/practical tests apply only to applicants of designated departments)

originalContent:
<[2027학년도 전과전형] 학과별 면접(실기)고사 세부 일정 안내>
1. 2027학년도 전과전형 주요일정
가. 공인영어성적 제출 마감: 2027. 01. 04.(월)까지 / 현 소속학과 사무실 제출
나. 전과 신청: 2027. 01. 06.(수) 10:00 ~ 01. 07.(목) 16:00
다. 면접(실기)고사: 2027. 01. 12.(화)
라. 합격자 발표: 2027. 01. 19.(화) 14:00 예정 / 홈페이지 공지
※ 공인영어성적 제출 및 전과 신청 기간 엄수(시간 연장 절대 불가)
2. 면접(실기)고사 안내
가. 면접(실기)고사 평가 대상학과만 시행
나. 대상학과 전체 2027. 01. 12.(화) 하루 동안 진행(학과별 진행 시간은 상이)
다. 학과별 진행 시간, 장소 및 운영방식(온라인, 오프라인 방식)은 첨부파일 참고
라. 기타 문의사항은 첨부파일 지원 학과사무실로 문의
3. [2027학년도 전과전형] FAQ: 첨부파일 참고
